cd /opt/trading-bot/positions && python3 -c "
import json,pos,datetime
d=json.load(open('positions.json'))
f=lambda t:datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t/1000,datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%H:%M')
for p in d:
    if p.get('src')!='chan' or p['status']!='closed' or p['reason']!='stop': continue
    k=pos.kl(p['sym'],'1m',limit=240,start=p['t_out'])
    if not k: print(p['id'],'nokl'); continue
    hi=max(float(x[2]) for x in k); lo=min(float(x[3]) for x in k); last=float(k[-1][4]); e=p['entry']
    s=1 if p['side']=='long' else -1
    fav=(hi-e)/e*100 if s==1 else (e-lo)/e*100
    adv=(lo-e)/e*100 if s==1 else (e-hi)/e*100
    tp=abs(p['tp']-e)/e*100
    print(p['id'],p['sym'][:-4],p['side'][0],p['rule'],'in',f(p['t_in']),'out',f(p['t_out']),'after4h fav%',round(fav,2),'adv%',round(adv,2),'end%',round((last-e)/e*100*s,2),'tp%',round(tp,2),'risk%',round(p['R_pct'],2),'n',len(k))
"
